rationale: M6R package creation succeeded, so changing packaging path is not supported by the failure evidence.
The HTTP 500 has a specific causal runtime mechanism: quantized V cache q4_0 with flash-attn off.
A single mechanism-specific intervention can be preregistered without altering Q4 bytes, Modelfile, fixtures, prompts, generation parameters, parity target, or reasoning mapping.

required_single_intervention.justification: f16 is the documented Ollama default KV-cache type and removes the exact quantized-V-cache precondition that caused llama_init_from_model to abort.
required_single_intervention.reason_flash_attention_not_changed: Current evidence does not establish that enabling flash-attention is supported or appropriate on this runtime/backend; changing it would introduce a second causal intervention.

preregistration_constraints: Use installed Ollama 0.34.2 exact binary/runtime family; no version change.
Keep eval_v1 fixtures and all generation parameters unchanged.
Keep parity and reasoning mapping criteria unchanged.
Prove the M6R2 server process sees KV cache f16 before attempt.
Do not modify global/user/machine Ollama environment settings as part of the experiment; prefer a process-scoped controlled runtime environment.
Do not enable flash-attention as a rescue.
Do not treat M6R2 as rewriting M6 or M6R outcomes.
One fresh attempt only after zero-science static QA and explicit execution authorization.
